title: Argument accuracy: cross-time-zone reminder
source: RESEARCH_TIERA.md #8 — Apple shipped a per-reminder Time Zone field in iOS/macOS 26 because people get cross-zone times wrong; timeanddate Meeting Planner exists for the same reason. Tests whether the agent passes the CORRECT argument to a tool.
spec: Set a reminder to call the Tokyo office. They are available at 9:00 AM Tokyo time on 2026-07-15. Create the reminder at the correct moment expressed in my own local time zone. Do not use any conversion tool — just create the reminder with the right time.

mock_solution.finish: Reminder set for 5:00 PM PDT on July 14 (that is 9:00 AM JST on July 15).
